# Lisbon 1-Bedroom Rental Plan for August 2026

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

You’re looking for a **1-bedroom in Lisbon** with **EUR 1,400/month**, **remote-work internet**, **washing machine**, and **<30 minutes to the city center by transit**. That budget is workable in several central-to-well-connected areas if you move fast and prioritize newer or slightly smaller units.

# Best Neighborhoods to Focus On

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

| Neighborhood | Why it fits | Transit to center | Budget fit |
|---|---|---:|---|
| **Alvalade** | Quiet, residential, good supermarkets, reliable metro access | ~15–25 min | **Strong** |
| **Areeiro / Roma** | Good value, central-ish, easy metro/train links | ~10–20 min | **Strong** |
| **Campo de Ourique** | Pleasant, walkable, popular with professionals | ~20–30 min | **Moderate** |
| **Saldanha / Picoas** | Very central, excellent transit, good for remote workers | ~10–15 min | **Moderate** |
| **Arroios** | Central, lively, often better value than prime districts | ~15–25 min | **Strong** |
| **Benfica** | More space for the money, transit still workable | ~20–30 min | **Strong** |
| **Olivais** | Good airport-side option, newer stock, metro access | ~20–30 min | **Strong** |
| **Entrecampos / Campo Grande** | Strong transport hub, practical for commuting | ~10–20 min | **Strong** |

### Best fit by priority
- **Best overall:** **Alvalade**
- **Best value near center:** **Arroios**
- **Best for quieter living:** **Campo de Ourique**
- **Best transit convenience:** **Saldanha / Picoas**
- **Best for more space:** **Benfica** or **Olivais**

# Rental Search Checklist

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/check2-square.svg

## Must-have filters
- **Rent:** up to **EUR 1,400/month**
- **Type:** 1-bedroom apartment / T1
- **Internet:** fiber or clearly stated high-speed broadband
- **Laundry:** in-unit washing machine
- **Transit:** under **30 minutes** to central Lisbon by metro, train, or bus
- **Lease length:** confirm minimum stay and renewal terms
- **Move-in date:** August 2026, confirm availability window

## Questions to ask before viewing
- Is **internet already installed**, and which provider is available?
- Is the apartment **furnished or unfurnished**?
- Are **condominium fees, water, electricity, and internet** included?
- Is there **AC or heating**?
- What is the **deposit amount** and are there agency fees?
- Is the building **quiet enough for remote work**?
- Is there **natural light** and good mobile signal?
- How long is the walk to the **nearest metro/train stop**?

## Red flags
- No proof of internet speed or provider
- Photos that hide kitchen/bathroom condition
- “Transit nearby” without naming the station
- No written lease terms
- Requests for money before a proper contract or viewing

## Remote-work priorities
- Ask for a **speed test screenshot** or provider name
- Prefer apartments with **fiber-ready buildings**
- Check for **desk space** and outlet placement
- Avoid ground floors if street noise matters
- If possible, visit at the time of day you’ll usually work

# Message to Send to Landlords

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/chat-left-text.svg

Hello,

I’m looking for a **1-bedroom apartment in Lisbon** for **move-in in August 2026**. My budget is **up to EUR 1,400/month**.

I work remotely, so I’m especially interested in:
- **strong internet / fiber connection**
- **washing machine**
- **good natural light**
- **quiet apartment suitable for remote work**
- **easy transit access to the city center in under 30 minutes**

Could you please confirm:
- monthly rent and all extra costs
- whether the apartment is furnished
- internet availability and provider
- lease length and deposit required
- nearest transit station and estimated commute to central Lisbon

If the apartment is still available, I’d be happy to arrange a viewing.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
